office_does: A Spokane County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases and traffic infractions, sets bail and holds preliminary hearings; all judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Patrick T Johnson is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Spokane County District Court judge since 2018, previously a deputy prosecutor for 20 years; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Judge since 2018, presiding over Veterans Court and criminal dockets [S1]
Deputy prosecuting attorney 1998-2018 and retired Army Reserve JAG major [S1]
Adjunct professor at Gonzaga University School of Law [S1]
